findings.summary: scripts/verify_integration.py accepts an authorization commit published under any governed namespace ref instead of requiring the exact PR/candidate ref named by the authorization record; a mismatched authorization ref therefore passes exact-tuple verification. Require and verify the exact refs/governance/authorizations/pr-<pr_number>/<candidate_sha> ref, reject additional/moved/reused mismatches as defined by policy, and add regression tests.

scripts/validate_gate_records.py does not enforce the finding schema and ignores all records carrying any non-null superseded_by without validating reciprocal linkage or successor existence. A malformed record is accepted, and an open MAJOR can be hidden with a fabricated superseded_by while a PASS record satisfies the gate. Enforce the JSON schema or equivalent exact nested validation, validate bidirectional acyclic supersession links and candidate/gate continuity, and retain unresolved blocking history; add negative factory tests.

scripts/validate_governance.py does not validate critical required-evidence structure such as evidence.required_gate_record_fields or candidate_identity_fields. Emptying required_gate_record_fields leaves validation green, so the canonical policy can lose a required critical control without CI detecting it. Assert all critical structured policy fields and relationships and add negative mutation tests for each required-evidence invariant.
